answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 44325 Country: India Title: Zikr Question: What should I read when I am reading name of Allah (for particular number of times) like Al-Malik or Ya-Malik. Answer ID: 44325 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 520/L=220/TL=1434) Read Ya Malik (يا مالك) and if you read Al-Malik (المالك) then there is no harm in it as it is correct to read only Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
